string.name: app_name
string.translation_description: The application name, shown under the launcher icon and in the app switcher.

string.name: splash_version

string.name: splash_dismiss

string.name: north_pole
string.translation_description: Short abbreviation for the North Celestial Pole, displayed as a label on the sky map grid. Translators: use the standard abbreviation in your language (e.g. NP in English, PN in French).

string.name: south_pole
string.translation_description: Short abbreviation for the South Celestial Pole, displayed as a label on the sky map grid. Translators: use the standard abbreviation in your language (e.g. SP in English, PS in French).

string.name: neptune

string.name: channel_passes_name
string.translation_description: Name of the notification channel for alerts shortly before a satellite passes overhead.

string.name: channel_passes_description
string.translation_description: Description of the satellite-pass notification channel.

resources.string: A single alert shortly before the best visible pass of the night

string.name: notif_pass_title
string.translation_description: Title of the notification sent shortly before a satellite passes overhead. %1$s is the satellite name.

string.name: notif_pass_text
string.translation_description: Body of the satellite pass notification, telling the user when to go outside. %1$s is a time.

resources.string: Visible from about %1$s — head outside and let your eyes adjust

string.name: channel_eclipses_name
string.translation_description: Name of the notification channel for alerts before a lunar eclipse starts.

string.name: channel_eclipses_description
string.translation_description: Description of the lunar-eclipse notification channel.

resources.string: A single alert before a lunar eclipse begins

string.name: notif_eclipse_title
string.translation_description: Title of the notification sent before a lunar eclipse starts. %1$s is a localized eclipse type like \'Total lunar eclipse\'.

string.name: notif_eclipse_text
string.translation_description: Body of the lunar eclipse notification, telling the user when it begins. %1$s is a time.

resources.string: Begins around %1$s — worth stepping outside for

string.name: satellite_name_iss
string.translation_description: Display name for the International Space Station.

string.name: satellite_name_tiangong
string.translation_description: Display name for the Chinese space station Tiangong.

string.name: satellite_description
string.translation_description: Short description shown on the info card for an artificial satellite.

resources.string: An artificial satellite in low Earth orbit, sunlit against a dark sky. It crosses from horizon to horizon in a few minutes, moving steadily and without blinking.

string.name: tonight_satellite_pass
string.translation_description: Tonight-widget row announcing a visible satellite pass. %1$s is the satellite name, %2$s is a time of day.

string.name: tonight_trailing_pass
string.translation_description: Small trailing note on a satellite pass row. %1$s is a compass direction, %2$d is an angle in degrees, %3$.1f is a brightness magnitude.

string.name: no_sensor_warning
string.translation_description: Warning shown when the device lacks the motion sensors needed to point the map at the sky automatically.

resources.string: This device has no compass or motion sensors, so Sky Map can\'t follow where you point it. Drag the map by hand instead.

string.name: no_sensor_warning_dismiss
string.translation_description: Button that dismisses the missing-sensors warning dialog.

string.name: hud_alignment_reset_message
string.translation_description: Snackbar confirming the sensor-alignment correction was cleared; shown with an Undo action.

string.name: ar_auto_mode_snackbar
string.translation_description: Snackbar shown when turning on through-camera mode switched the map from manual dragging back to automatic sensor pointing.

resources.string: Auto mode turned on for the camera view

string.name: ar_permission_denied
string.translation_description: Snackbar shown when the user declined the camera permission that through-camera mode needs.

resources.string: Through-camera mode needs the camera permission

string.name: ar_permission_settings_action
string.translation_description: Snackbar action opening the app\'s system settings page so the user can grant the camera permission after permanently denying it.

string.name: ar_alignment_adjusted_message
string.translation_description: Snackbar shown after the user drags the star map to align it with the camera image; shown with an Undo action that reverts the whole drag.

string.name: share_chooser_title
string.translation_description: Title of the system share sheet when sharing a captured sky image.

string.name: share_invitation
string.translation_description: Short invitation stamped on the footer of shared sky images, above the store link.

resources.string: The Universe in your pocket — get Sky Map free

string.name: share_text
string.translation_description: Text accompanying a shared sky image in apps that accept both an image and text. %1$s is the app-store link.

resources.string: The Universe in your pocket — get Sky Map free: %1$s

string.name: share_layout_overlay
string.translation_description: Caption of the share-layout choice that draws the star map over the camera photo, as seen on screen.

string.name: share_layout_side_by_side
string.translation_description: Caption of the share-layout choice that puts the camera photo and the star map next to each other.

string.name: share_failed_message
string.translation_description: Snackbar shown when capturing the sky image for sharing failed.

resources.string: Couldn\'t capture the sky — try again

string.name: snackbar_action_undo
string.translation_description: Snackbar action button that reverses the change the snackbar reports, e.g. re-enabling horizon auto-leveling

string.name: snackbar_action_open
string.translation_description: Snackbar action button that opens the screen the snackbar refers to, e.g. the compass calibration screen

string.name: label_size_hint_message
string.translation_description: Snackbar shown once, the first time the user zooms in a long way. Explains that the text labels naming stars and other objects stay the same size however far you zoom, and that their size is changed in the app\'s Settings screen instead. Shown with an action button that opens Settings.

resources.string: Label size doesn\'t change with zoom — set it in Settings

string.name: label_size_hint_action
string.translation_description: Action button on the label size snackbar; opens the app\'s Settings screen, where the user can change how large the sky labels are

string.name: gallery_title
string.translation_description: Title of the screen showing a gallery of photographs of celestial objects. Not the user\'s own photos - these are catalog images from sources such as NASA and ESA.

string.name: gallery_back
string.translation_description: Content description for the back arrow leaving the gallery screen

string.name: settings_title
string.translation_description: Title of the settings screen

string.name: settings_ok
string.translation_description: Confirm button in settings dialogs

string.name: settings_cancel
string.translation_description: Cancel button in settings dialogs

string.name: settings_section_controls
string.translation_description: Preferences category heading for touch control settings

string.name: settings_section_appearance
string.translation_description: Preferences title for section about app appearance

string.name: settings_section_sensors
string.translation_description: Preferences category heading for sensor settings

string.name: settings_section_other
string.translation_description: Preferences category heading for miscellaneous settings such as the usage statistics opt-out

string.name: enable_analytics
string.translation_description: Preference label to opt in to sending anonymous usage statistics

string.name: enable_analytics_desc
string.translation_description: Description/summary for the usage statistics preference

resources.string: Make Sky Map better by sending anonymous data to Google Analytics

string.name: settings_diagnostics_summary
string.translation_description: Summary for the settings row that opens the diagnostics screen, which shows technical sensor, location and performance readouts useful when reporting a problem

string.name: settings_section_advanced
string.translation_description: Preferences category heading for advanced or experimental settings that most people will not need to change

string.name: settings_renderer
string.translation_description: Preference title for choosing which graphics engine draws the sky map

string.name: settings_renderer_summary
string.translation_description: Summary explaining the graphics engine preference: the newer engine draws a more realistic sky and clearer labels, and the map restarts when the setting is changed

resources.string: The newer engine draws a more realistic daytime and twilight sky, and clearer labels. The map restarts when you change this.

string.name: settings_renderer_gles1
string.translation_description: Name of the original, long-standing graphics engine option, shown in a list of two choices

string.name: settings_renderer_gles3
string.translation_description: Name of the newer graphics engine option, shown in a list of two choices

string.name: settings_tap_to_identify
string.translation_description: Preference title for showing info cards when tapping objects

string.name: settings_tap_to_identify_summary
string.translation_description: Preference summary for the tap info feature

resources.string: Tap celestial objects to learn about them

string.name: settings_tap_in_auto_mode
string.translation_description: Preference title for enabling info cards in auto/sensor mode

string.name: settings_tap_in_auto_mode_summary
string.translation_description: Preference summary for auto mode info cards

resources.string: Also show info cards when tapping objects in automatic (sensor) mode

string.name: settings_auto_level_horizon
string.translation_description: Preference title for the auto-level horizon feature in manual mode

string.name: auto_level_on_toast
string.translation_description: Brief confirmation shown when a double tap turns horizon auto-leveling on in manual mode

string.name: auto_level_off_toast
string.translation_description: Brief confirmation shown when a double tap turns horizon auto-leveling off in manual mode

string.name: settings_auto_level_horizon_summary
string.translation_description: Summary for the auto-level horizon preference

resources.string: In manual mode, the horizon gradually returns to horizontal after you lift your fingers

string.name: settings_font_size
string.translation_description: Preference title: change the size of the text labels naming stars and other objects drawn on the sky

string.name: settings_font_size_summary
string.translation_description: Help to go along with the sky label size preference. Explains that this size is fixed and does not change as the user zooms the map in or out.

resources.string: Label text stays this size at any zoom

string.name: settings_font_size_small
string.translation_description: Smallest font size

string.name: settings_font_size_medium
string.translation_description: Normal font size

string.name: settings_font_size_large
string.translation_description: Large font size

string.name: settings_font_size_extra_large
string.translation_description: Largest font size

string.name: settings_auto_dimness
string.translation_description: Preference title: mode for automatically dimming the screen when night mode is selected

string.name: settings_auto_dimness_summary
string.translation_description: Summary for the night-mode screen dimming preference

resources.string: How much night mode dims the screen

string.name: settings_auto_dimness_system
string.translation_description: Screen dimming option: leave brightness on the system setting

string.name: settings_auto_dimness_dim
string.translation_description: Screen dimming option: dimmest screen setting

string.name: settings_auto_dimness_classic
string.translation_description: Screen dimming option: the hand-tuned brightness Sky Map used for its first 15 years

string.name: settings_disable_gyro
string.translation_description: Preference title for switching from the gyroscope to the legacy compass + accelerometer sensor pipeline

string.name: settings_disable_gyro_summary
string.translation_description: Explanation of the legacy sensors preference and when to use it

resources.string: Point the map using the compass and accelerometer instead of the gyroscope. Try this if the map drifts or your device\'s gyro misbehaves; devices without a gyro use these sensors automatically.

string.name: settings_classic_sensors_only
string.translation_description: Summary noting a sensor preference only applies to the legacy non-gyroscope sensor path

resources.string: Only applies when legacy sensors are in use

string.name: settings_smoothing
string.translation_description: Preference title for the switch that turns sensor smoothing on or off

string.name: settings_smoothing_summary
string.translation_description: Explanation of the sensor smoothing switch: it steadies the sky view, is on by default during a beta trial, invites feedback, and explains how to turn it off

resources.string: Steadies the sky view. This is new and on by default while we tune it — if you notice lag, jitter, or anything odd, we\'d love to hear about it. Turn it off here any time if you\'d rather use the raw sensor.

string.name: settings_steadiness
string.translation_description: Preference title for how much the sky view is steadied while the phone is held still

string.name: settings_steadiness_summary
string.translation_description: Explanation of the steadiness preference and its trade-off

resources.string: How much the view is steadied while you hold the phone still. Higher settings shake less but take a moment longer to settle.

string.name: settings_steadiness_low
string.translation_description: Least steadying of the view when the phone is held still

string.name: settings_steadiness_medium
string.translation_description: Moderate steadying of the view when the phone is held still

string.name: settings_steadiness_high
string.translation_description: Strong steadying of the view when the phone is held still

string.name: settings_steadiness_very_high
string.translation_description: Very strong steadying of the view when the phone is held still

string.name: settings_steadiness_extreme
string.translation_description: Extremely strong steadying of the view when the phone is held still, for devices with noisy sensors

string.name: settings_ease_off
string.translation_description: Preference title for how much the steadying relaxes once the phone starts moving

string.name: settings_ease_off_summary
string.translation_description: Explanation of the ease-off preference and its trade-off

resources.string: How much the steadying relaxes once you start moving, so the view keeps up with you. Choose None to steady the view by the same amount whether it is still or moving.

string.name: settings_ease_off_none
string.translation_description: Steadying does not relax at all when the phone moves

string.name: settings_ease_off_low
string.translation_description: Steadying relaxes a little when the phone moves

string.name: settings_ease_off_medium
string.translation_description: Steadying relaxes a moderate amount when the phone moves

string.name: settings_ease_off_high
string.translation_description: Steadying relaxes a lot when the phone moves

string.name: settings_reverse_magnetic_z
string.translation_description: Preference title for reversing the magnetometer Z axis, a workaround for devices with a mis-mounted compass sensor

string.name: settings_magnetic_correction
string.translation_description: Preference label: apply magnetic declination correction so the compass points to true north instead of magnetic north

string.name: settings_magnetic_correction_summary
string.translation_description: Summary for the magnetic correction preference

resources.string: Corrects the compass for the difference between magnetic and true north

string.name: settings_view_direction
string.translation_description: Preference title for choosing the view/pointing direction mode

string.name: settings_view_direction_summary
string.translation_description: Explanation of the view direction preference, covering both landscape rotation and pointer modes

resources.string: Rotate horizon by 90 degrees (for devices with forced landscape) or use pointer mode for the screen to show what the top of the phone is pointing at

string.name: settings_view_direction_standard
string.translation_description: Normal viewing direction

string.name: settings_view_direction_rotate90
string.translation_description: View direction option that rotates the screen by 90 degrees

string.name: settings_view_direction_telescope
string.translation_description: View direction option that shows the sky as pointed at by the long edge of the phone

string.name: support_email

string.translation_description: Map-screen button that opens the diagnostics screen

string.translation_description: Title bar text for the diagnostics screen

string.translation_description: Accessibility label for the diagnostics screen button that emails these details to the developers

string.name: diagnostics_share_subject
string.translation_description: Subject line of the email a user sends from the diagnostics screen

string.name: diagnostics_section_graphics

string.translation_description: Row label in the diagnostics screen for graphics hardware limits (maximum texture size, supported line widths and point sizes)

string.translation_description: Format for the GL limits row: maximum texture size in pixels, then the supported line width and point size ranges. \'tex\' abbreviates texture. %1$d is texture size, %2$s is the line width range, %3$s is the point size range.

string.name: diagnostics_gl_unavailable
string.translation_description: Value shown in the diagnostics Graphics rows before the sky map has drawn, when the graphics details are not known yet

string.name: diagnostics_section_sensors
string.translation_description: Section heading in the diagnostics screen for sensor readings

string.name: diagnostics_accelerometer
string.translation_description: Row label in the diagnostics screen for the accelerometer sensor

string.translation_description: Row label in the diagnostics screen for the compass (magnetic field) sensor

string.name: diagnostics_gyroscope
string.translation_description: Row label in the diagnostics screen for the gyroscope sensor

string.name: diagnostics_rotation
string.translation_description: Row label in the diagnostics screen for the rotation vector (combined orientation) sensor

string.name: diagnostics_rotation_matrix
string.translation_description: Row label in the diagnostics screen showing the raw device rotation matrix used for orientation

string.name: diagnostics_light_level
string.translation_description: Row label in the diagnostics screen for the ambient light sensor reading

string.name: diagnostics_sensor_absent
string.translation_description: Sensor status shown in diagnostics when the sensor is not present on the device

string.name: diagnostics_section_orientation_settings
string.translation_description: Section heading in the diagnostics screen for the user-adjustable settings that shape the sensor readings shown above it

string.translation_description: Row label in the diagnostics screen for which sensor path supplies device orientation

string.name: diagnostics_steadiness
string.translation_description: Row label in the diagnostics screen for the orientation smoothing filter's steadiness setting

string.name: diagnostics_ease_off
string.translation_description: Row label in the diagnostics screen for the orientation smoothing filter's ease-off setting

string.translation_description: Value shown for the calibration dialog row when the automatic dialog is suppressed

string.name: diagnostics_calibration_dialog_shown

string.name: calibration_what_to_do
string.translation_description: Information for the user on how to calibrate the compass when the screen auto-opens. Placeholder is the video URL. Please do not change the < and > markup - the <blockquote> renders as a highlighted callout

resources.string:
Your phone\'s compass sensor is reporting poor calibration. The figure-8 motion (watch a demonstration) prompts your phone\'s hardware to reset its compass sensor — Sky Map has no control over this process.

Calibrated does not mean accurate. The figure-8 gesture helps reset the sensor, but it cannot remove interference from nearby metal objects, car dashboards, or phone cases. If the map is still off after calibrating, those external sources are the most likely cause — not Sky Map.
Move to an open area away from metal and try again.

string.name: calibration_what_to_do_user
string.translation_description: Information for the user on how to calibrate the compass when they open the calibration screen. Placeholder is the video URL. Please do not change the < and > markup - the <blockquote> renders as a highlighted callout

resources.string:
Your phone is reporting its compass calibration status as shown above.

If necessary, perform the figure-8 motion (watch a demonstration) to prompt your phone\'s hardware to recalibrate its compass sensor.

Important: calibration helps the sensor reset itself internally. It does not mean the compass is necessarily accurate! Local magnetic interference (metal objects, car dashboards, phone cases) can still cause your phone\'s compass to send inaccurate readings to Sky Map.
If the map isn\'t showing positions correctly the problem is likely your phone - not Sky Map!
